title: Open Values Lens v0.1
description: A facts file for one kind of choice, such as banking: the criteria options are scored on, and every option with its scores from 0 to 100 and the source for each score. The site that publishes it keeps it, and anyone can copy it and correct it.

format.description: "open-values-lens" when present. Conscious Consuming's own facts files leave it out.

version.description: The version of the lens format this file follows, 0.1, when present.

meta.description: What the file covers and where its facts come from: its id, name, kind, sources, licence and starting weight settings.

criteria.description: The things each entry is scored on, such as fossil-fuel financing or fees. Every score key used by an entry must be listed here.

products.description: The entries being compared, in Conscious Consuming's own facts files. A file has either products or resources, never both.

resources.description: The entries being compared, in facts files written for other apps that share the format, such as Kosplora's learning resources. A file has either products or resources, never both.

id.description: The file's id, in lower case with hyphens, such as "banking". It is unique across the catalogue and does not change.

label.description: The name shown to people, such as "Banking".

type.description: What kind of thing the entries are: Products, Services, Media, Organizations or Initiatives.

domain.description: The area of life the file belongs to in navigation, such as "Money" or "Food & drink".

source.description: Where the facts come from as a whole, either the name of an open database or a note that the facts were researched by hand for this file.

attribution.description: A paragraph shown with the rankings: what the file covers, which sources each criterion is read from, what is left empty and why, and when it was last reviewed.

license.description: The licence the file's underlying data is published under, such as "ODbL 1.0" for data from Open Food Facts or Open Beauty Facts.

allergens.description: True for food and beauty files, where the app shows allergen information and lets a person exclude products by allergen. False hides those controls.

productBase.description: A web address that an entry's code is added to, to link each entry to its record in the open database the facts came from, such as "https://world.openbeautyfacts.org/product/". Corrections then go to that database.

presets.description: Ready-made weight settings a person can pick, keyed by the name shown on the button, such as "Balanced". If there are none, the app makes a Balanced preset with every criterion at 3.

governance.description: Who may change the file and how changes are agreed, for files that take proposals from more than one group.

decision.description: How the file is read as a decision: the plain sentence saying what it compares, the criteria that sentence rests on, and the trade-offs and picks the app shows. Defined in the decision contracts format.

w.description: The weight this preset gives each criterion, from 0 (ignore) to 5 (matters most), keyed by criterion key.

x.description: Allergen tags this preset excludes, such as "peanut". A product is kept only when its data says it is free of each one. Usually empty.

policy.description: The name of the change policy the file follows, such as "format-seed".

whoMayMerge.description: Who may accept a proposed change into the file.

quorum.description: How much support a proposed change needs before it is accepted, or a note that no quorum exists yet.

discussion.description: Where proposed changes to the file are recorded, such as a path to a proposals file.
